title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode2 A Gift From My Big Sis

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Episode: Episode2 — A Gift From My Big Sis
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(This package is huge!
What on earth did Sis send me?)
se_event_ribbon_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
It's full of clothes!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, she must've made these!
Wow... It's cool to see that she can make stuff like this now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can tell that this young designer making a name for herself abroad has the right stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? There's something else really deep down... What is this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, this ribbon's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? A greeting card...? Let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Greeting Card
rows.Line: <To Mizuki, the cutest person in the world>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Sis. “Cutest” might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But since she sent this to me, I think I'll try it on♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, she's right... I do definitely look cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But this ribbon and all these clothes... It's like she's written her signature on all of them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's great to see that Sis is having fun over there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, she even sent snacks!
These are just as cute and colorful...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, come to think of it...
Miku and the others might really like it if I shared some of this candy with them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll take some of these over to them! They'll probably love it too since they came from overseas♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, here we go!!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see. Where are Miku and the...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ready, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
Look over there♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Look over... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Look over here♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess you can't help but look the same way I point my finger, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: O-Once more time...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha... Luka's such a meanie.
Hey, over here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome.
Just you today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I was sent some snacks you don't see very often and decided to share them with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Snacks...
Rin and Len might like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, they might.
Oh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki, that ribbon looks lovely on you. Is it new? Did you just buy it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this came with the snacks.
My big sis sent it to me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your big sister...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a big sister who's much older than me. She's still just starting out, but she's a fashion designer.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's living abroad right now and has it kinda tough right now... But she's working really hard towards achieving her dream of owning her own business.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Her own business overseas...?
That's very ambitious of her. Has she been living abroad long?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I'd say pretty long... She moved right around the time I joined N25.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you joined N25, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kanade and Mafuyu told us a story about how N25 initially came to be, but we didn't get to hear about when you and Ena joined, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
The timing felt a bit off to get into that, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you mind telling us about that?
I'm sure Miku's already bored of playing rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm not bored, but...
I'd also like to hear more about that, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you do?
I mean, it's really not that interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
I can't really say no to these faces, can I?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright... I'll try going in order, starting with around the time I was in my last year of junior high.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really had a lot on my mind back then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That was when I heard one of Kanade's songs and decided that I wanted to start making music videos.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You had a lot on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... We're talking about A LOT...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Things were so hard back then...)
About one year ago
Junior High School - Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“Ahem. Good morning, everyone.
The cherry blossoms lined up near our school are all in full bloom, and it gives me great pleasure to welcome in a new school year.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(*Yawn*
Another boring opening ceremony...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's always such a pain to have to start again in a completely new class. So is dealing with the first years.)
se_event_ribbon_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that the person they were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe. The description my big brother gave me seems pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ugh... I would've been able to ditch if the teachers hadn't found me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I can just head up to the rooftop after this. Rui's also probably pretty bored and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Right. He graduated...)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“That concludes this speech.
Everyone, let's all do our best to make the most of this school year.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, let's try talking to that person!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, they seem like fun.
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finally, some alone time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place really is nice and quiet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's nice and quiet, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I just thought up a wonderful idea for an effect. Would you like to hear?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't mind a little noise...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (However, before Rui started coming up here, this was normal...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, it's like nothing's changed...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm back to square one.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another dull day at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And another dull year that I have to survive...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's not like there's anything I can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, MiraMagi's on today!
I have to watch it as it airs!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The final episode's also coming up... Man, I really don't want to see this show end.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Despite it being an evening children's anime, it has such a good story. Not only that, the characters are cute and people always write great comments about this show on forums...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And above all else, the protagonist's enemy and rival, Mia, is just too adorable!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe... I can't wait to see what the finale's like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also. I heard that they're gonna do some promos and stuff to get everyone excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, here we go...!
The “Let's Root For MiraMagi Together” promotional campaign!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, we're allowed to make videos for this. I might just have to take a crack at it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, lemme just turn on my PC...
And I can give that effect plugin I bought the other day a try.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I started doing this to kill time when I'm bored, but I'm really glad that I started making my own videos...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get to choose whatever music, assets, effects and everything else I like while also being able to edit it however I please. Not only that, it lets me focus in a way that I can block out all unnecessary distractions.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Before I entered junior high, I made my own clothes and accessories...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, how should I do this...?
I could try creating a montage of all the best scenes up to this point...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm coming in.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, are you making a MiaMagic video?
You really do love that show, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis, it's not “MiaMagic”. It's called “MiraMagi”! Or “Miracle Magic Girl ☆ Lala”! The animated epic about Lala, the magical girl who's fighting to save the day, that's all the rage right now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While Mia's the girl who's her enemy and rival, so please don't get them mixed up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Ah, right. Yes.
Haha. I'm sorry, Mizuki. I must've gotten them mixed up since you seem to really enjoy talking about Mia.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be fair, it is kinda confusing...
Anyway, did you need something from me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, I was just packing up my things and found all these clothes that I'd made in the past. Would you like them, Mizuki? They're all in this box.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really? Can I see?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, you used to make this kind of stuff...?! You really are an amazing designer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Although, my fashion school teachers didn't really like this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the ones at that school in France called you a genius, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: A genius...? I really don't think I was called that, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Over here, my teachers would say that my designs were “far too radical” without even really looking at what I'd drawn. I was even turned away by so many others when it came time to look for a job...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which is why I was so happy when I discovered peers who believed the opposite of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know you went through a lot and had to work really hard... But I'm also happy that they acknowledged your talents!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Sis, good luck over there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? I'm not leaving until next month.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Still, Mizuki, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
...
By the way... How have you been recently...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me?
Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, school can be a real drag sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I get to watch my favorite anime and make videos about it, so I'd say I'm in a good place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Remember, I'm always here to listen if something does end up bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Especially since we won't get many chances to chat like this in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis!
But I'm okay. There's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm just gonna do what I can to enjoy the present!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, you two, I bought some cake. Would you like to have some?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, cake? Yes, please!
Let's go, Sis!
